title: North or South? Diagnosing LLMs' Understanding of North Korean Language, Society, and Knowledge

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model accuracy on semantically equivalent STEM short-answer questions presented in English, South Korean, and North Korean varieties to measure linguistic robustness and performance degradation on low-resource language variants.

Using multiple-choice questions to test sociocultural perspective alignment by comparing model responses when prompted from a South Korean versus a North Korean perspective, analyzing errors like liberal-democratic projection and stereotype overcorrection.

Assessing domain-specific knowledge and sociocultural reasoning to identify whether models default to external, liberal-democratic ideological assumptions rather than accurately reflecting the lived realities and institutional contexts of North Korea.
